system.description:
You perform a devastating round house kick with enough force to kick up a shockwave. Make a melee taijutsu attack targeting a creature in range On a hit, you deal your [Unarmed damage] + 2d4 and the target must make a Strength saving throw, being pushed back 10 feet on a failed save.

Finisher: All creatures in a 15-foot cone originating from you must make a Strength saving throw, taking your [Unarmed damage] + 4d4, being push back 10 feet and falling Prone on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful save.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and damage by 1d4 or 1d6.
